```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(ggrepel)
```

# Prepare urinary metabolite data
```{r}
# Read timepoint key
key_long <- read.csv(
  "../data/derived/timepoint_key_long.csv"
)

# Read urinary metabolite concentrations
met_raw <- read_excel(
  "../data/raw/urine-metabolomics/Dan Urine Anthocyanin 11-10-2022.xlsx",
  sheet = "concentration ng mL"
)

# Convert metabolite table from wide to long format
met <- met_raw %>%
  rename(metabolite = 1) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^\\d+-V\\d+$"),
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "value",
    values_transform = list(value = as.character)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    value = readr::parse_number(value)
  ) %>%
  separate(
    Sample,
    into = c("Subject.Number", "v"),
    sep = "-",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number),
    v = toupper(v)
  )

sum(is.na(met$value))
table(met$v)
head(met)
```

#Add metabolite timepoint labels
```{r}
key_long_clean <- key_long %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number),
    v = toupper(substr(timepoints, 11, 12)),
    v = if_else(
      v == "-V",
      toupper(substr(timepoints, 12, 13)),
      v
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Subject.Number,
    v,
    Timepoint
  ) %>%
  distinct()

met <- met %>%
  left_join(
    key_long_clean,
    by = c("Subject.Number", "v")
  )

# Check timepoint matching
table(met$Timepoint, useNA = "ifany")
```
#Create pre-BRB, post-BRB and metabolite-change table
```{r}
met_brb <- met %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("rB", "tB")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(
    Subject.Number,
    metabolite,
    Timepoint
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metabolite_change = tB - rB
  )

head(met_brb)
```
#Prepare CRP data
```{r}
cytokines <- read.csv(
  "../data/derived/cytokines_avg-results.csv"
)

sample_key <- read.csv(
  "../data/derived/timepoint_key.csv"
)
```

#Assign cytokine samples to study timepoints
```{r}
sample_labels <- sample_key %>%
  select(
    Subject.Number,
    placebo
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number),

    preP = if_else(
      placebo == "Week 0",
      1,
      3
    ),

    postP = if_else(
      placebo == "Week 0",
      2,
      4
    ),

    preBRB = if_else(
      placebo == "Week 0",
      3,
      1
    ),

    postBRB = if_else(
      placebo == "Week 0",
      4,
      2
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      preP,
      postP,
      preBRB,
      postBRB
    ),
    names_to = "timepoint.label",
    values_to = "visit"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = paste0(
      Subject.Number,
      "-",
      visit
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Sample,
    Subject.Number,
    timepoint.label
  )
```

#Extract CRP values

```{r}
crp <- cytokines %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    Sample = gsub("^0", "", Sample),
    Sample = gsub("\\.1$", "", Sample)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    cytokine == "C.Reactive.Protein.CRP"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    sample_labels,
    by = "Sample"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    timepoint.label %in% c(
      "preBRB",
      "postBRB"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number),
    CRP = as.numeric(avg.res)
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    Subject.Number,
    timepoint.label
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    CRP = mean(CRP, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = timepoint.label,
    values_from = CRP,
    names_prefix = "CRP_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CRP_change = CRP_postBRB - CRP_preBRB
  )

head(crp)
```
#Combine metabolites with CRP
```{r}
met_crp <- met_brb %>%
  inner_join(
    crp,
    by = "Subject.Number"
  )

# Number of matched participants
n_distinct(met_crp$Subject.Number)

# Check CRP distributions
summary(met_crp$CRP_preBRB)
summary(met_crp$CRP_postBRB)
summary(met_crp$CRP_change)
```
#Function for Spearman correlations
```{r}
run_spearman <- function(
    data,
    metabolite_variable,
    crp_variable,
    analysis_name
) {

  data %>%
    group_by(metabolite) %>%
    group_modify(
      ~ {
        x <- .x[[metabolite_variable]]
        y <- .x[[crp_variable]]

        complete <- complete.cases(x, y)

        x <- x[complete]
        y <- y[complete]

        n_complete <- length(x)

        if (
          n_complete < 5 ||
          length(unique(x)) < 2 ||
          length(unique(y)) < 2
        ) {
          return(
            tibble(
              n = n_complete,
              rho = NA_real_,
              p.value = NA_real_
            )
          )
        }

        test <- suppressWarnings(
          cor.test(
            x,
            y,
            method = "spearman",
            exact = FALSE
          )
        )

        tibble(
          n = n_complete,
          rho = unname(test$estimate),
          p.value = test$p.value
        )
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      p.adj = p.adjust(
        p.value,
        method = "BH"
      ),
      analysis = analysis_name,
      significant_raw = p.value < 0.05,
      significant_FDR = p.adj < 0.05
    ) %>%
    arrange(p.adj, p.value)
}
```

#Baseline metabolite abundance vs baseline CRP
```{r}
cor_baseline <- run_spearman(
  data = met_crp,
  metabolite_variable = "rB",
  crp_variable = "CRP_preBRB",
  analysis_name = "Baseline metabolite vs baseline CRP"
)

cor_baseline
```
#Post-BRB metabolite abundance vs post-BRB CRP
```{r}
cor_post <- run_spearman(
  data = met_crp,
  metabolite_variable = "tB",
  crp_variable = "CRP_postBRB",
  analysis_name = "Post-BRB metabolite vs post-BRB CRP"
)

cor_post
```
#Metabolite change vs CRP change
```{r}
cor_change <- run_spearman(
  data = met_crp,
  metabolite_variable = "metabolite_change",
  crp_variable = "CRP_change",
  analysis_name = "Metabolite change vs CRP change"
)

cor_change
```
#Combine all results
```{r}
cor_results_all <- bind_rows(
  cor_baseline,
  cor_post,
  cor_change
)

cor_results_all
```
#View nominally significant correlations
```{r}
cor_results_all %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(analysis, p.value)
```
#View FDR-significant correlations
```{r}
cor_results_all %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(analysis, p.adj)
```

#Save results
```{r}
write_csv(
  cor_results_all,
  "../data/derived/urinary_metabolite_CRP_correlations.csv"
)

write_csv(
  cor_results_all %>%
    filter(p.value < 0.05),
  "../data/derived/urinary_metabolite_CRP_nominally_significant.csv"
)

write_csv(
  cor_results_all %>%
    filter(p.adj < 0.05),
  "../data/derived/urinary_metabolite_CRP_FDR_significant.csv"
)
```

#Correlation results plot
```{r}
cor_plot <- cor_results_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(rho), !is.na(p.value)) %>%
  mutate(
    label = if_else(
      p.value < 0.05,
      metabolite,
      NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = rho,
      y = -log10(p.value),
      label = label
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      shape = significant_FDR
    ),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_label_repel(
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ analysis,
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Spearman correlation coefficient (rho)",
    y = "-log10(p-value)",
    shape = "FDR significant"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

cor_plot
```
```{r}
significant_change_metabolites <- cor_change %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  pull(metabolite)

if (length(significant_change_metabolites) > 0) {

  individual_plot <- met_crp %>%
    filter(
      metabolite %in% significant_change_metabolites
    ) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = metabolite_change,
        y = CRP_change
      )
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      se = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ metabolite,
      scales = "free_x"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Change in urinary metabolite abundance (post − pre)",
      y = "Change in CRP (post − pre)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)

  print(individual_plot)

  ggsave(
    "../figures/significant_metabolite_CRP_change_correlations.svg",
    plot = individual_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 5
  )
}
```
